summary: Gaotu Techedu Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 2, 2026, reporting its unaudited first-quarter 2026 financial results. The release covers net revenues of RMB1,689.5 million (up 13.2% YoY), income from operations of RMB6.9 million, and net income of RMB34.5 million. It also notes approximately RMB704 million in share repurchases through aggregate programs as of June 1, 2026. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or structural change is announced. The filing is a routine earnings report for a foreign private issuer, providing financial performance updates without any special-situation event.
